data_policy: Forecasts must be traceable to a snapshot and model version.
Missing values remain missing and are surfaced; they are not silently imputed by recommendation code.
Exploratory covariance is not a production decision signal.
Forecast validity and point-in-time status travel with every recommendation response.

forecast_quality.policy: Always disclose source coverage and limitations; do not label exploratory or non-point-in-time data as validated.

player_record_rules.fpl_element_id: Positive integer FPL element ID; unique within one forecast snapshot.
player_record_rules.expected_points: Finite numeric expected FPL points for the declared forecast horizon; negative values are allowed.
player_record_rules.expected_minutes: Finite non-negative expected minutes for the declared forecast horizon.
player_record_rules.price: Finite positive FPL price in £m units.
player_record_rules.effective_ownership_pct: Optional non-negative percentage; values above 100 are valid because captaincy/chip exposure can exceed one unit per manager. If any EO values are supplied, forecast_quality.data_coverage must include cohort, sample size, pre-deadline cohort capture time, target deadline, post-deadline picks capture time and picks_lock_verified=true; the EO deadline must equal the forecast target deadline.
player_record_rules.points_variance: Optional non-negative variance estimate; only use as a decision signal after validation.

general_market.purpose: Rank players and market opportunities independently of any manager squad.
general_market.decision_policy: Current engine ranks the supplied EV baseline and price; sampled EO is accepted only with a verified pre-deadline cohort, post-deadline picks, sample size and matching target deadline. CoVar is excluded.
general_market.invariance: For identical forecast snapshot, model version, horizon and public filters, output is identical regardless of any manager squad or personal constraints.

personal_squad.purpose: Optimise decisions for one explicitly supplied manager squad and constraints.

squad_snapshot.purchase_price_rule: Finite positive FPL purchase price in £m units.

composition.policy: Validate composition using the position and team_id from the shared forecast records; every owned player must have a forecast record.

personal_squad.portfolio_policy: Evaluate moves against the whole squad and constraints, not incoming-player rank in isolation. Current v0.1 evaluates one transfer and does not use CoVar or apply an unvalidated risk profile.

portfolio_risk.covariance_policy: Exploratory CoVar is excluded from production decisions until stability and out-of-sample validation gates pass.
portfolio_risk.scope: CoVar may inform personal portfolio decisions after validation; it is not a required component of general player rankings.

acceptance_tests: General mode validates and runs without any squad input.
General mode rejects all personal squad and manager-specific fields.
General rankings are invariant to personal squad changes.
Personal mode requires exactly 15 distinct FPL element IDs.
Personal mode requires explicit bank, free-transfer count and risk profile.
Personal mode records the squad snapshot and constraints used.
Both modes record forecast snapshot, model version and horizon.
Missing or unvalidated forecast fields are surfaced, not invented.
Exploratory covariance is not used as a production decision signal.
